items.quote: Please don't ever use the word presentation. No one wants to be on a presentation, right?
items.statement: Avoid using the word 'presentation' when booking Zoom meetings, as it is off-putting to clients.

items.quote: they're not going to go on a Zoom meeting with you if they don't see the reason for themselves.
items.statement: Typically, clients reject Zoom meeting invitations if they do not see personal benefit.

items.statement: Frame the invitation to a Zoom meeting around the client's potential gain instead of your agenda.

overview: YouTube short discussing how to effectively book Zoom meetings with potential buyers.
